notes:
Short-form account notes / latest:
- Mid-market analytics SaaS (product help + insights).
- Trial -> now heading to Dedicated sizing.
- Primary ask: predictable latency for chat (p99 target ~<500ms), embeddings for search must be <50ms per vector on dedicated for hot path.
- After Hosted API trial they provided real traffic sample (1 week) — used by SE to model QPS and token mix.
- Observed token mix (trial): ~45% chat (avg 600 tokens / call), ~55% embeddings (avg 8 tokens per embed request). Peak traffic pattern: daily peaks at 09:00-11:00 PST, bursty at product launches.
- Redwood SE recommended: Dedicated baseline to cover steady-state 40–60 QPS with autoscale headroom to 150 QPS for launches; recommend warming KV cache and soft-fallback routing to smaller model variant during saturation.
- Pricing notes: initial committed baseline $25k/mo proposed; procurement pushing for 10% discount on annual commit + 30-day termination for pilot phase. Finance wants TCO comparisons vs self-hosting GPU fleet.
- Security: require SSO/SAML, SOC2 evidence, audit logs retention 12 months, KMS support (customer-managed keys), and EU data residency for a subset of customer data.
- Quote from CTO: "Main ask is predictable economics and no surprises on latency under load — we can tolerate slight quality delta if it keeps latency consistent."
- Next steps: finalize Dedicated sizing doc (SE to deliver by 2026-03-12), legal to review residency addendum, CFO exec review 2026-03-18.
- Helpful artifacts: drive/pricing deck, sizing spreadsheet, hosted trial token logs (shared).
dedicated_sizing_summary:
SE recommended: baseline 4x A100-equivalent nodes for steady 50 QPS, autoscale group to 10 nodes for bursts to 150 QPS. Enable KV prefix caching for common prompts and continuous batching for embeddings. Expected token mix impacts sizing: embeddings-heavy (55%) reduces generation node needs but increases embedding pool throughput.
Cost model: committed baseline $25k/mo; burst overage priced per 1M tokens. 12-month commit gives ~10% discount.
qps_concurrency_estimate: Steady QPS: 40-60; Peak QPS (launch days): 120-150; Typical concurrency target: 15-30 active sessions; token mix: embeddings 55% (short calls), chat generation 45% (avg 600 tokens).
forecast_assumptions: 10% monthly growth during first year after GA
90th% of traffic from NA; 10% EU (data residency concerns)
